sql: SELECT s.School, s.DOC FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded')

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2, s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3 FROM schools s JOIN satscores st ON (s.CDSCode = st.cds OR s.CDSCode = '0' || st.cds) WHERE st.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.Charter = 0 AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18
SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND s.GSoffered = 'K-8' AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY s.City
SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2 FROM schools WHERE County = 'San Bernardino' AND City = 'San Bernardino' AND DOC = '54' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND SOC = '62'

SELECT MAX(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM satscores st JOIN frpm f ON (f.CDSCode = st.cds OR f.CDSCode = '0' || st.cds) WHERE st.rtype = 'S' AND 1.0 * st.NumGE1500 / st.NumTstTakr > 0.3
SELECT f."School Name", s.Street FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30

SELECT f."School Name" FROM frpm f JOIN satscores st ON (f.CDSCode = st.cds OR f.CDSCode = '0' || st.cds) WHERE st.rtype = 'S' AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1 AND st.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT st.sname, f."Charter Funding Type" FROM satscores st JOIN frpm f ON (f.CDSCode = st.cds OR f.CDSCode = '0' || st.cds) WHERE st.rtype = 'S' AND st.dname LIKE 'Riverside%' AND st.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT f."School Name", s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey' AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)' AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800

SELECT s.School, st.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone FROM schools s JOIN satscores st ON (s.CDSCode = st.cds OR s.CDSCode = '0' || st.cds) WHERE st.rtype = 'S' AND (s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01')
SELECT "Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)" AS ratio FROM frpm ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores st JOIN schools s ON (s.CDSCode = st.cds OR s.CDSCode = '0' || st.cds) WHERE st.rtype = 'S' AND st.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT s.CharterNum, st.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY st.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools s JOIN satscores st ON (s.CDSCode = st.cds OR s.CDSCode = '0' || st.cds) WHERE st.rtype = 'S' AND st.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
